title: China Just Dropped a FREE AI That Reads 100-Page PDFs in One Shot 🤯 #shorts  #ai #technology
description:
China's tech giant, Baidu, just open-sourced a massive 3 billion parameter AI model that is changing how we process documents. It’s called Unlimited-OCR, and it can read a 100-page PDF in a single shot.

While traditional OCR tools chop your documents into tiny pieces and lose the context, Unlimited-OCR processes the entire file perfectly with zero memory loss. I tested it by handing it a 40-page scanned contract, and it returned perfectly clean text—keeping every table and heading exactly where it belongs.

Why this AI tool is a game-changer:

One-Shot Processing: Reads up to 100 pages without breaking the document into pieces.

Flawless Formatting: Perfectly extracts text, tables, and complex layouts from scanned PDFs.

100% Private & Local: It runs entirely on your own hardware, meaning none of your sensitive documents ever leave your laptop.

Completely Free: Grab it from Hugging Face and set it up in under two minutes with a single terminal command.
